source.label: Gold analytical base · snapshot 23/09/2026
source.description: User-exported MySQL view airbnb_sg_2026.vw_gold_bi_analytical_base. One row per listing snapshot.

metricDefinitions.label: Valid listed price
metricDefinitions.definition: SGD currency, verified SGD flag = 1, listed price > 0. Median and interpolated P25/P75 recomputed from listing rows.

metricDefinitions.label: Available nights ratio
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum calendar_available_nights divided by sum calendar_total_nights.

metricDefinitions.label: Review score
metricDefinitions.definition: Unweighted mean across listings with scores from 1 to 5.
